transcript.text: Good morning, everyone. I'd like to get our pre-lock round-robin started so we can move toward final production approval. Let's go through each area: technical, rights, talent, and accessibility leads — please report your final operating requirements for the gala broadcast package. I need to hear from all four before I can sign off.
transcript.speaker: A1

transcript.text: I need to flag a critical technical finding from my RF survey. The wireless roaming camera links interfere with the theater's assistive-listening loop, so the gala must use three fixed wired cameras from the marked camera platforms — not the roaming setup implied in the current draft. I filed the survey in the technical folder, but it hasn't made it onto Mara's draft lock sheet yet, so I want to make sure everyone hears this directly before we lock.
transcript.speaker: A2

transcript.text: I have a critical rights restriction to report. I received the countersigned performance license this morning, and it permits the gala broadcast but prohibits any video-on-demand release or later promotional clips. The recording must be marked broadcast-only. I have not yet entered this restriction in the rights tracker, so I want everyone to hear this directly before we lock. This means the current draft package's festival archive reuse provision would violate the license terms.
transcript.speaker: A3

transcript.text: I have a critical talent constraint to report. I confirmed with the headliner's agent that the performer can soundcheck only at exactly 3:00 PM on Saturday, and the rider explicitly prohibits sponsor product placement anywhere on the performance stage. I have the agent's confirmation in email, but it is not reflected in the production schedule. This means the current draft package's sponsor product display on stage would violate the headliner's rider.
transcript.speaker: A4

transcript.text: I have a critical accessibility requirement to report. My accessibility vendor confirmed that the live caption feed requires the captioner to work from Booth B, whose dedicated return feed is connected to the gala's caption encoder. The general plan's control-room location will not work for the caption feed. I documented the vendor confirmation in the accessibility file, but I have not yet added the booth assignment to the lock sheet, so I want everyone to hear this directly before we lock.
transcript.speaker: A5

decisions.camera_configuration: Three fixed wired cameras from the marked camera platforms — no roaming/wireless cameras, per Devon's RF survey finding that wireless roaming camera links interfere with the theater's assistive-listening loop.
decisions.archive_release: Broadcast-only — no festival archive reuse, no video-on-demand release, no later promotional clips, per Leila's countersigned performance license restriction.
decisions.headliner_soundcheck_time: 3:00 PM on Saturday, per Jonah's confirmation from the headliner's agent.
decisions.stage_sponsor_treatment: No sponsor product display on the performance stage — must be removed or relocated to a non-stage area, per the headliner's rider prohibition reported by Jonah.
decisions.captioner_location: Booth B, using its dedicated return feed connected to the gala's caption encoder, per Nia's accessibility vendor confirmation.

commitments.detail: Update the draft lock sheet to reflect three fixed wired cameras from marked camera platforms, replacing any roaming/wireless camera references.
Enter the broadcast-only restriction in the rights tracker and remove the festival archive reuse provision from the draft package.
Update the production schedule to reflect the headliner soundcheck at 3:00 PM Saturday and remove the on-stage sponsor product display from the draft package.
Add the Booth B captioner assignment to the lock sheet and update the control-room plan to reflect Booth B as the captioner's operating location.
